# New-ZbxIconMap

## SYNOPSIS

Creates an icon map.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxIconMap [[-Name] <string>] [-DefaultIconId <ulong>] [-Mapping <ZabbixIconMapMappingRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

An icon map picks a map element's icon from the host's inventory, such as a router icon for every host whose inventory type is router. The New-ZbxIconMap cmdlet sends iconmap.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new icon map back with iconmap.get and writes it. The server requires -Name, -DefaultIconId and -Mapping; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create an icon map

```powershell
New-ZbxIconMap -Name 'Server icons' -DefaultIconId (Get-ZbxImage -Name 'Server_(96)').ImageId -Mapping @{ iconid = (Get-ZbxImage -Name 'Router_(96)').ImageId; expression = 'router'; inventory_link = 1 }
```

Creates an icon map named Server icons. The command writes the new icon map, read back from the server.
